main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean of sign(forecast) x (5-bar return minus coin's mean 5-bar return)

statistic.name: t of weighted mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with t >= 2 and convexity check passes; reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper-minus-lower half mean signed excess return per unit |raw position|

decided_by: The t is between -2 and 2 (or sign and t disagree), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Grid at positions 0,5,10,... of each window with cases where forecast != 0; coin mean 5-bar return taken over that same grid on all its windows; t is cluster-robust by calendar day; halves split at the median |raw| (ties to the lower half) and 'per unit' is the half's mean signed excess return (unweighted) divided by its mean |raw|; calm is regime not 'chop'.
